content_of_post_to_comment: Most of my non-tech friends don't care about AI agents, custom software, Navier-Stokes, AI apocalypse, Astra, and Mythos. They're using ChatGPT as advanced search, to ask health questions, and to draft emails or create silly images. They don't know what Claude Code or Codex is. The benefits of advances in AI are real, they're just not evenly distributed.
comment: The interesting divide may not be access to AI itself, but access to the mental models needed to see new uses. The next gap could be between AI users and AI discoverers.
